Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring that CPR be included in high school curriculum.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to instruction in cardiopulmonary resuscitation inhigh school health and fitness curriculum; and adding a new section tochapter 28A.230 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.230RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All high schools in the state shall include in their health andfitness curriculum instruction in cardiopulmonary resuscitation basedon uptodate instructional methods and materials. A high school maycollaborate with local agencies such as police or fire departments orcommunity organizations such as the Red Cross to offer the instruction.
